bugGuidance: Tell us what happened and what you expected
digestHint: One Telegram message each morning with what is yours today.
incTasks: My tasks due today and overdue
previewHint: Built from today's data with your saved settings.
qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
recoveryHint: Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only this once.
recoveryTitle: Two-factor is on. Save these recovery codes now.
require2faHint: Anyone without it is sent to set it up at their next sign-in, and cannot use Helm until they do.
requiredHint: An owner has made two-factor sign-in required for the team. Set it up to continue using Helm.
securityHint: Helm can see every client's money and open every client's dash. A password alone is not enough for that.
step1: Open Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or any authenticator app.
step2: Scan this code, or type the key below.
sureToLogout: Are you sure you want to log out of Helm?
turnOffWithCode: To turn it off, enter a current code
twoFactorIsOff: Two-factor sign-in is off — set it up
twoFactorOffHint: Add a code from your phone to your password, so a leaked password is not enough to get in.
twoFactorOnHint: You are asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in, and again before actions that are hard to undo.
usernameHint: Then open @octopos_helm_bot and press Start, so it is allowed to write to you.
